stemMarkdown: The speed of a boat in still water is 12 km/h and the speed of the stream is 5 km/h. How many hours does the boat take to travel 60 km downstream? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream the current helps, so the effective speed is $12 + 5 = 17$ km/h. Time $= \dfrac{60}{17} = 3.5294$ hours.
